dz: 日本天皇天皇引入了水钟(clepsydra),取名"罗可克". 用于测量时间和时间的仪器被放置在QŌtsu首都.
de: Emperor Tenji of Japan introduces a water clock (clepsydra) called Rokoku. The instrument, which measures time and indicates hours, is placed in the capital of Ōtsu.
